task: Privacy consent, truthful song requests and release Game Center gating

changes.transport: Foundation-only AnalyticsTransport serializes generation validity, token creation and URLSession task creation with NSRecursiveLock. Revocation invalidates the lease, removes tracked tasks and calls cancel synchronously. Completed old requests cannot acknowledge a newer consent generation. Delayed retry blocks check their captured lease and become no-ops after revocation. URLSession callbacks leave the lock before completion; explicit-submission callbacks are dispatched outside the telemetry queue and locks.
changes.batching: Telemetry retains existing 20-event / 30-second / background flush behavior. Saved sharing is synchronously applied, pending events and timer discarded on opt-out, active requests canceled. A signal captures its consent generation before queueing, preventing old work from silently becoming valid after off/on. Shared transport starts disabled until AppStore applies the saved/default preference, so an unexpectedly early event cannot bypass saved opt-out.
changes.attribution: AppleAdsReporter replaces detached untracked task. Token creation, initial POST, retry scheduling, response processing, resulting analytics upload and sent-marker persistence all use the same lease. At most three lookup attempts, five seconds apart. A revoked run cannot clear a newer active lease. Country/region removed from output whitelist; only attribution flag, campaign/ad-group/keyword and conversion information remain. The sent marker requires accepted telemetry delivery rather than merely logging or queueing.
changes.song_request: Explicit request sends immediately, independent of routine event batching. Only documented HTTP 200 ingestion acceptance produces success and clears input. HTTP errors, unconfigured analytics and revoked consent return failure. UI retains input on failure, displays pending state, rechecks availability at send time and provides disclosure plus always-available Cloudflare Support. No automatic setting change, opt-in shortcut or repository link was added.
changes.logging: Preserved parent's event-name-only OS logging; no public event property values or song titles written by Analytics.log.
changes.game_center: TimbreGameCenterEnabled reads TIMBRE_GAME_CENTER_ENABLED, default NO. Explicit true and nonautomated run required; activation, pending GameKit activity check, authentication callback, listener registration and activity entry respect the gate. Other GameKit operations remain unreachable without active authentication. Local games, local score/challenge state and ordinary challenge links remain available. Enabling later still requires Apple capability/entitlement, App Store Connect configuration and assets.
changes.manifest: Added DeviceID, PurchaseHistory and OtherUserContent with Analytics purpose, linked false, tracking false. Existing ProductInteraction/AdvertisingData/CrashData/PerformanceData retained. Global tracking false and existing required-reason API entries preserved.
changes.configuration: Preserved root's https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy build setting; AppLinks.support adds https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/support. No site, policy, store copy or provenance artifact changed by this implementation.
